selectivity_definition: Fraction of documents passing the complete fast-field predicate; target bucket names are approximate.

scenarios.name: single_topk
scenarios.sql: SELECT * FROM hn_items WHERE text ||| $1 ORDER BY pdb.score(id) DESC LIMIT 10

scenarios.name: text_and_ff_50pct
